headline: Weathered Expanse Holds Hot as Berm and Strand Flare
war_summary: Since the evening filing the map has shifted on several active fronts while older pushes have cooled. The Weathered Expanse remains the heaviest sector with 39 changes in twenty-four hours, including five in the last two, and holdings now list two Warden and seven Colonial with none unheld around Crow's Nest, Shattered Advance and Wightwalk, with day losses near 12,100 Colonial and 17,700 Warden. Palantine Berm has quickened to four changes in two hours, nine in six, totalling twelve, with holdings at five Warden to two Colonial about The Pippeli Stones. Kuura Strand counts eleven changes, four in two, at five Warden to one Colonial about Talven and Menneen. Callahan's Passage has stirred again with three changes in two hours for ten on the day at eight Warden to two Colonial, while the Nevish Line totals seventeen with two in two and ten in six at five Warden to three Colonial. Stlican Shelf has eased to one change in two hours though twenty-seven stand on the day, and Stonecradle and Linn Mercy report no changes in six hours.
